_comment: Menus of other mods that Inventory Tweaks knows how to handle. An entry applies to its class and to its subclasses.
Entries of config/InvTweaks/menu_compat.json (same format) are read after these and win over them.
Keys: class (required), showButtons (default true), validInventory (default false), validChest (default false),
largeChest (default false), rowSize (default 9, or "auto" to count the chest columns on the screen),
chestSlots (public method of the menu without parameters returning the number of leading chest slots or a collection
of the chest slots; without it, every slot that is not the player's inventory is the chest),
inventoryButtons (default false: the sorting buttons sort the player's inventory and nothing else of the menu is
ever touched; implies validInventory). Other keys, like comment, are ignored.

menus.comment: Sophisticated Storage (barrels, chests, shulker boxes) and Sophisticated Backpacks. The storage slots come first in the menu; upgrade slots are not menu slots.
Applied Energistics 2 terminals: ME, crafting and pattern encoding terminals, their wireless versions and the ME chest. Only the player's inventory is sorted.
Applied Energistics 2 pattern access terminal. Only the player's inventory is sorted.
AE2 Wireless Terminal Library: wireless crafting terminal (also opened by the universal terminal).
AE2 Wireless Terminal Library: wireless pattern encoding terminal (also opened by the universal terminal).
AE2 Wireless Terminal Library: wireless pattern access terminal (also opened by the universal terminal).
